tools.name: estimate_api_cost
tools.description: Estimate the cost of a workload (tokens per request times requests) on up to six models using Kingy's currently verified standard rates. Applies long-context tiers; models without a current verified price are listed as unavailable with the reason.

tools.name: compare_subscription_plans
tools.description: US prices, features and conditions for consumer AI subscriptions (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini/Google AI, Copilot), each with its price check date and official sources.

tools.name: get_usage_limits
tools.description: Documented usage limits (messages, credits, rate limits, reset windows) for AI products and plans such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Perplexity, Midjourney and the major APIs, with review status and source. Call with no product to list covered products.

tools.name: check_model_access
tools.description: Kingy Can I Use: whether a specific model can be used for a purpose, through a route (direct API, third-party provider or open weights), in a jurisdiction (US, Canada, EU, UK). tools.name: find_model_changes
tools.description: Reviewed AI platform changes from official vendor sources: model retirements and deprecations, breaking API changes, migration deadlines, access and price changes, each with the affected model ids, deadline, required action and sources. Use it to check whether a model id in your code is being retire

tools.name: can_i_run_locally
tools.description: Kingy's verdict on running a model on your own hardware: Yes, Yes but slow, Barely, No or Not tested yet, per machine type (8GB GPU PC or laptop, 16GB laptop, 24GB Mac, 24GB or 32GB GPU PC, 64GB Mac, 128GB Mac or Strix Halo, 512GB Mac Studio). tools.name: list_ai_shutdowns
tools.description: The Kingy AI Graveyard: dated shutdowns of AI tools, retirements of AI models and business transitions, with citations and alternatives Kingy reviewed.

tools.name: search_kingy
tools.description: Search kingy.ai articles, original tests, comparisons and tools. Returns titles, URLs, dates and short excerpts.

tools.name: what_changed_since
tools.description: Every recorded change across Kingy's datasets since a date: API price and spec changes, usage-limit and plan changes, new or updated shutdowns and retirement deadlines, new launches, and reviewed retirements or breaking changes. Each event has before/after values, the Kingy page and the official sou

tools.name: estimate_monthly_bill
tools.description: Turn a daily usage pattern (requests per day, tokens per request) into a cost per day and per period for up to six models, using Kingy's currently verified rates. Models without a current price are listed as unavailable with the reason.

tools.name: find_models_that_fit
tools.description: Filter currently priced models by maximum input or output price (USD per 1M tokens), minimum context window, minimum output tokens, provider, or a Kingy home-hardware verdict, sorted by price or context. Facts only: it does not rank quality.

tools.name: list_ai_launches
tools.description: Dated AI model, tool and feature launches from the Kingy AI Launch Tracker, newest first, with categories, launch types, attributes such as open-weight or API-available, the official announcement and the Kingy record.

tools.name: get_ai_deadlines
tools.description: Model retirement and shutdown dates across direct APIs and cloud platforms (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Mistral, xAI, DeepSeek), each with certainty, scope, required action, replacement guidance and the official source. Upcoming first.

tools.name: get_price_index
tools.description: Monthly index of AI prices: median verified API list prices per tier (frontier, mid-range, small) and typical subscription prices, with month-over-month change, constituents and the headline. Optionally the full edition history. CC BY 4.0.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_price_index" appears informational but accepts parameters (history) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_model_prices" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
